title: Kessler Shield Contract Holder Points Expiry Extension — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
The expiry period that ages Owner Rewards points on a Service Accounts and Repair Orders account also follows the customer's Kessler Shield contracts, as the Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts records show, and the account's tier:

- where the customer holds an active Kessler Shield service contract and the account is at Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Platinum, the expiry period is lengthened by 3 months;
- where the customer holds one and the account is at Kessler Owner Rewards Silver, it is lengthened by 2 months;
- otherwise it is not lengthened by a contract.

Any active contract the customer holds counts, on any vehicle.

| Active Kessler Shield contract held | Gold or Platinum | Silver | Other tiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | 3 months | 2 months | none |
| No | none | none | none |

**Hypothetical.** A Silver account with a tier expiry period of 12 months and an active contract ages points under a 14-month period: a point 13 whole months old at the run is not aged; one 15 whole months old is.
